strings.zh: 你好,我是口袋妖怪饲育家凉叶,{NEWLINE}如果你也是带精灵来看病的,{CLEAR}请稍微等一会儿吧。{CLEAR}我现在正在帮一只{CLEAR}病情非常复杂的精灵诊疗。
strings.en: Hello, I’m Fern, a Pokémon Breeder. If{NEWLINE}you’ve brought a Pokémon to be seen{CLEAR}too, please wait a little while.{SCROLL}Right now I’m treating a Pokémon with a{NEWLINE}very complicated condition.
strings.notes: 凉叶 → Fern (invented; Pokémon Breeder). 夏希 → Mr. Summers (invented).

strings.zh: 啊……靠凉叶小姐好近啊,{NEWLINE}凉叶小姐的发丝好细啊,{CLEAR}凉叶小姐身上的味道好香啊……
strings.en: Ahh... I’m so close to Miss Fern... Her{NEWLINE}hair is so fine...{SCROLL}And she smells so nice...

strings.zh: 你干什么？离我远点！{NEWLINE}不要打扰我跟凉叶小姐独处！
strings.en: What do you want? Get away from me!{NEWLINE}Don’t interrupt my time{CLEAR}alone with Miss Fern!

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉,你能告诉我{NEWLINE}你究竟是哪里不舒服吗？
strings.en: Chatot, can you tell me where exactly it{NEWLINE}hurts?

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『我头疼！我头疼！
strings.en: Chatot: My head hurts! My head hurts!

strings.zh: 唉,我已经给你检查过头了,{NEWLINE}完全没问题啊……{CLEAR}难道是我技术不行,{CLEAR}没有发现病灶所在？
strings.en: Sigh... I already checked your head,{NEWLINE}and there’s nothing wrong at all...{SCROLL}Am I just not skilled enough to find the{NEWLINE}cause?

strings.zh: 凉叶小姐不要着急,请慢慢检查！
strings.en: Don’t rush, Miss Fern. Take your time{NEWLINE}with the checkup!

strings.zh: 你放心,我一定会帮音符鹦鹉{NEWLINE}尽快解除病痛的。
strings.en: Don’t worry. I’ll make your pain go away{NEWLINE}as soon as I can, Chatot.

strings.zh: 要让你的音符鹦鹉{NEWLINE}尝试着与这只音符鹦鹉交流一下吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Have your Chatot try talking to this{NEWLINE}Chatot?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 教音符鹦鹉哪句话去交流呢？{SCROLL}
strings.en: What should your Chatot say to it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你好呀
strings.en: Hello!

strings.zh: 你吃了吗
strings.en: Have you eaten?

strings.zh: 我肚子疼
strings.en: My tummy hurts

strings.zh: 是装的
strings.en: I’m faking

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『你好呀。
strings.en: Chatot: Hello!

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『我头疼！你好呀！
strings.en: Chatot: My head hurts! Hello!

strings.zh: 这位训练家,请不要打扰我治疗！
strings.en: Excuse me, Trainer, please don’t{NEWLINE}interrupt the treatment!

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉,咱们继续治疗吧。
strings.en: Chatot, let’s continue your treatment.

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『好呀！你好呀！
strings.en: Chatot: Okay! Hello!

strings.zh: 我警告你,不要不要多管闲事！
strings.en: I’m warning you. Mind your own{NEWLINE}business!

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉,你是说你还头疼吗？
strings.en: Chatot, are you saying your head still{NEWLINE}hurts?

strings.zh: 唉,真是遇到疑难杂症了……
strings.en: Sigh... This really is a baffling case...

strings.zh: 不着急,凉叶小姐。你慢慢治,{NEWLINE}我会在这里陪着你的。
strings.en: No rush, Miss Fern. Take your time. I’ll{NEWLINE}stay right here with you.

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『你吃了吗？
strings.en: Chatot: Have you eaten?

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『我头疼！你吃了吗？
strings.en: Chatot: My head hurts! Have you eaten?

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『吃了吗？你吃了吗？
strings.en: Chatot: Eaten? Have you eaten?

strings.zh: 谢谢你关心我啊音符鹦鹉,{NEWLINE}不过在治好你之前我都没什么食欲。{CLEAR}咱们还是继续治疗吧。
strings.en: Thanks for worrying about me, Chatot,{NEWLINE}but I won’t have much appetite until{CLEAR}you’re better.{SCROLL}Let’s continue your treatment.

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『我肚子疼。
strings.en: Chatot: My tummy hurts.

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『我头疼！我肚子疼！
strings.en: Chatot: My head hurts! My tummy hurts!

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『肚子疼！我肚子疼！
strings.en: Chatot: Tummy hurts! My tummy hurts!

strings.zh: 唉？现在又肚子疼了吗……{NEWLINE}这病情又更复杂了,{CLEAR}我得好好想想办法。
strings.en: Huh? Now your tummy hurts too...? This{NEWLINE}is getting even more complicated.{SCROLL}I need to think this through.

strings.zh: 好的,音符鹦鹉,{NEWLINE}我知道你现在头疼和肚子疼。{CLEAR}我这就为你设计治疗方案。
strings.en: All right, Chatot. I understand your{NEWLINE}head and tummy hurt.{SCROLL}I’ll work out a treatment plan for you{NEWLINE}right away.

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『是装的。
strings.en: Chatot: I’m faking.

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『我头疼！是装的！
strings.en: Chatot: My head hurts! I’m faking!

strings.zh: 你说什么音符鹦鹉？你的头疼是装的？
strings.en: What did you say, Chatot? Your{NEWLINE}headache is fake?

strings.zh: 音符鹦鹉『装的！是装的！
strings.en: Chatot: Faking! I’m faking!

strings.zh: 夏希先生！！！{NEWLINE}我说怎么检查了这么久都没查出病因,{CLEAR}原来是你在让音符鹦鹉装病啊！
strings.en: Mr. Summers!!! No wonder{NEWLINE}I couldn’t find the cause no{CLEAR}matter how long I looked!{SCROLL}You were making Chatot pretend to be{NEWLINE}sick!

strings.zh: 啊,不……我……{NEWLINE}对不起……凉叶小姐,我……
strings.en: Ah, n-no... I... I’m sorry... Miss Fern,{NEWLINE}I...

strings.zh: 算了,看到音符鹦鹉没病{NEWLINE}我也就放心了,{CLEAR}请你以后不要再做这样的事了。
strings.en: Never mind. I’m just relieved Chatot{NEWLINE}isn’t sick.{SCROLL}Please don’t ever do anything like this{NEWLINE}again.

strings.zh: 是,是……我……我知道了。
strings.en: Y-yes... I... I understand.

strings.zh: 你真是个爱管闲事的家伙,{NEWLINE}咱们走着瞧吧,我跟你没完！
strings.en: You’re a real busybody, you know that?{NEWLINE}Just you wait. This isn’t over!

strings.zh: 谢谢你帮我发现音符鹦鹉装病的事,{NEWLINE}这些精灵用的营养品就当是谢礼了,{CLEAR}请你收下吧。
strings.en: Thank you for figuring out that Chatot{NEWLINE}was faking.{SCROLL}Please take these Pokémon supplements{NEWLINE}as thanks.

strings.zh: 我的目标是成为像尼比市的小刚馆主{NEWLINE}那样厉害的饲育家,{CLEAR}可是目前来看我还差得远,{CLEAR}连精灵是不是真的病了都看不出来……{SCROLL}不行,我不能灰心,{NEWLINE}继续努力才是我的风格。
strings.en: My goal is to become a great breeder{NEWLINE}like Brock, the Pewter Gym Leader...{SCROLL}But I still have a long way to go. I{NEWLINE}couldn’t even tell if a Pokémon was{CLEAR}really sick...{SCROLL}No, I can’t lose heart. Working hard{NEWLINE}and keeping at it is my style.

strings.zh: 水都群岛一带水域众多,{NEWLINE}真的是个非常适合垂钓的地方。
strings.en: There’s water everywhere around the{NEWLINE}Alto Mare Islands. It’s a perfect place{CLEAR}for fishing.

strings.zh: 呀,你身上带着的那个是高级钓竿！{NEWLINE}看来你也是一位资深的钓鱼达人。{SCROLL}我曾经走遍关东、城都、水都的水域,{NEWLINE}对整个地区的水系精灵分布了如指掌。{SCROLL}如果你想知道{NEWLINE}哪只珍稀水系精灵的分布,{CLEAR}我可以告诉你哦。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh, that’s a Super Rod you’ve got! You{NEWLINE}must be a seasoned angler too.{SCROLL}I’ve fished all the waters of Kanto,{NEWLINE}Johto and Alto Mare. I know where{CLEAR}every Water type lives.{SCROLL}If you want to know where to find{NEWLINE}a rare Water-type Pokémon,{CLEAR}I can tell you.{SCROLL}

strings.en: Whenever you want to check where these{NEWLINE}Pokémon live, come see me anytime.

strings.zh: 我在华蓝市北面4号水路{NEWLINE}曾经看到过杰尼龟趴在岸边{CLEAR}晒它的王八壳。
strings.en: I once saw a Squirtle sprawled on the{NEWLINE}bank of the Route 4 waters north of{CLEAR}Cerulean City...{SCROLL}...sunning its turtle shell.
strings.notes: zh 华蓝市北面4号水路 kept literally (Route 4).

strings.zh: 有一次我在城都地区的48号路游唦,{NEWLINE}小锯鳄一下子从水里冒出来{CLEAR}把我下了一跳。
strings.en: Once when I was swimming on Route 48 in{NEWLINE}Johto, a Totodile popped out of the{CLEAR}water and gave me a real scare.

strings.zh: 我在9号水路钓鱼的时候,{NEWLINE}被大舌贝夹到了脚。{CLEAR}当时痛了好几天呢。
strings.en: When I was fishing on Route 9, a{NEWLINE}Shellder clamped onto my foot. It hurt{CLEAR}for days.

strings.zh: 19号路周围的海面,{NEWLINE}经常会有墨海马浮上来{CLEAR}向路过的人讨要食物。
strings.en: In the sea around Route 19,{NEWLINE}Horsea often surface{CLEAR}and beg passersby for food.

strings.zh: 丑丑鱼可是非常少见,{NEWLINE}我只在12号路附近的海域{CLEAR}见到过有人钓上来。
strings.en: Feebas is really rare. I’ve only ever{NEWLINE}seen someone fish one up in the waters{CLEAR}near Route 12.

strings.zh: 传说水君被封印在缘朱市的烧焦塔,{NEWLINE}如果想得到水君,必须要先解开封印。
strings.en: Legend says Suicune is sealed in the{NEWLINE}Burned Tower in Ecruteak City.{SCROLL}If you want Suicune, you’ll have to{NEWLINE}break the seal first.

strings.zh: 我在双子岛最底层的洞穴,{NEWLINE}见到过一面石壁上{CLEAR}刻着关于盖欧卡的文字。{CLEAR}它很可能就沉睡在那里。{CLEAR}但是如何唤醒沉睡的盖欧卡{CLEAR}就不得而知了。
strings.en: In the deepest cave of the Seafoam{NEWLINE}Islands, I saw words about Kyogre{CLEAR}carved into a stone wall.{SCROLL}It may well be sleeping there.{NEWLINE}But how to wake the sleeping{CLEAR}Kyogre, nobody knows.

strings.zh: 我在水都群岛的公共海域,{NEWLINE}见到过与其他精灵玩耍的玛纳菲哦！
strings.en: I’ve seen Manaphy playing with other{NEWLINE}Pokémon in the public waters of the Alto{CLEAR}Mare Islands!

strings.zh: 你好啊,训练家之星,{NEWLINE}欢迎来到极梅婆婆的训练屋。{CLEAR}婆婆她人就在里面,你进去找她就好。
strings.en: Hello there, rising star! Welcome to{NEWLINE}Granny Mae’s training hall.{SCROLL}Granny’s inside. Just go on in and see{NEWLINE}her.

strings.zh: 你好啊,训练家之星,{NEWLINE}欢迎来到极梅婆婆的训练屋。{CLEAR}婆婆她人就在里面,你进去找她就好。
strings.en: Hello there, rising star! Welcome to{NEWLINE}Granny Mae’s training hall.{SCROLL}Granny’s inside. Just go on in and see{NEWLINE}her.

strings.zh: 这位黄头发的训练家{NEWLINE}就是你找来的伙伴吧,{CLEAR}既然已经凑齐了两位挑战者,{CLEAR}那么可以开启试炼了。
strings.en: This blond-haired Trainer must be the{NEWLINE}partner you found.{SCROLL}Now that we have two challengers, the{NEWLINE}trial can begin.

strings.zh: 你好,这里是极梅婆婆的道馆,{NEWLINE}看你这样子,也是来学习终极绝招的吧。{CLEAR}按照极梅婆婆定下的规矩,{CLEAR}要学习终极绝招{CLEAR}必须要通过道馆设下的试炼。{SCROLL}但这个试炼也不是随时开启的,{NEWLINE}而是每凑齐两位挑战者{CLEAR}才会开启一次试炼。{CLEAR}如果你想挑战学习终极绝招的试炼,{CLEAR}就去找一个伙伴跟你一起参加吧。
strings.en: Hello. This is Granny Mae’s Gym. You{NEWLINE}look like you’ve come to learn an{CLEAR}ultimate move too.{SCROLL}By Granny Mae’s rules,{NEWLINE}you must pass this Gym’s trial{CLEAR}to learn an ultimate move.{SCROLL}But the trial isn’t held at any time.{NEWLINE}It only begins once two{CLEAR}challengers are gathered.{SCROLL}If you want to take on the trial for the{NEWLINE}ultimate move, go find a partner to take{CLEAR}part with you.

strings.zh: 现在请你站到南侧来,{NEWLINE}我要向你们正式宣读试炼规则了。
strings.en: Now, please stand on the south side.{NEWLINE}I will formally read out{CLEAR}the rules of the trial.

strings.zh: 两位挑战者,非常欢迎你们来参加{NEWLINE}极梅婆婆道馆的终极绝招试炼。{CLEAR}这里的试炼共分四个阶段,{CLEAR}分别是：单打实力鉴定、精灵知识问答、{CLEAR}双打实力鉴定以及极梅婆婆的考核。{SCROLL}前三个阶段需要你们各自去完成,{NEWLINE}最后再由极梅婆婆对你们进行考核。{CLEAR}通过最终考核后,{CLEAR}你们将从极梅婆婆那里{CLEAR}学到无与伦比的终极绝招。{SCROLL}此外,本次试炼中途不允许退出,{NEWLINE}一旦有人失败你们就必须从头再来。
strings.en: Challengers, welcome{NEWLINE}to the ultimate-move{CLEAR}trial of Granny Mae’s Gym.{SCROLL}The trial has four stages:{NEWLINE}a Singles battle assessment,{CLEAR}a Pokémon knowledge quiz...{SCROLL}...a Doubles battle assessment, and{NEWLINE}finally Granny Mae’s own test.{SCROLL}You must each clear the first three{NEWLINE}stages alone. Then Granny Mae will test{CLEAR}you both.{SCROLL}Pass her final test, and you’ll{NEWLINE}learn a peerless ultimate{CLEAR}move from Granny Mae herself.{SCROLL}Also, there’s no quitting partway{NEWLINE}through this trial. If either of you{CLEAR}fails, you both start over.

strings.zh: 现在请你们在两侧引导员的带领下{NEWLINE}分别开始挑战吧。
strings.en: Now, follow the guides on either side{NEWLINE}and begin your challenges.

strings.zh: 我将带你开展第一阶段的试炼,{NEWLINE}请跟我来吧。
strings.en: I’ll take you through the first stage of{NEWLINE}the trial. Please follow me.

strings.zh: 在这里我将与你进行{NEWLINE}单打规则的实力鉴定,{CLEAR}请尽全力击败我吧！
strings.en: Here I will assess your strength{NEWLINE}under Singles rules.{CLEAR}Give it your all and beat me!

strings.zh: 很感谢你帮我学会骑车,{NEWLINE}但这座岛是我们「水都暴走族」的首领{CLEAR}带我们一起建立的家园,{CLEAR}要让我们跟其他人共享,{CLEAR}你得自己去找首领谈才行。{SCROLL}这样吧,我先去找首领说明情况,{NEWLINE}你随后来跟首领谈这件事,{CLEAR}我就能在旁边帮你说说好话了。
strings.en: I’m really grateful you taught me to{NEWLINE}ride. But this island is the home our{CLEAR}Chief built for us...{SCROLL}...the Alto Mare Bikers. If you want us{NEWLINE}to share it, you’ll have to talk to the{CLEAR}Chief yourself.{SCROLL}Tell you what. I’ll go explain{NEWLINE}things to the Chief first.{CLEAR}Then you come talk to him...{SCROLL}...and I can put in a good word for you.

strings.zh: 三之岛作为废弃的工业区,{NEWLINE}经过我的一番努力{CLEAR}终于被改造成了景区。{SCROLL}如今游客们陆续来到了这里,{NEWLINE}我总算是没有白忙一场啊。
strings.en: Three Island was an abandoned{NEWLINE}industrial zone. Thanks to all my hard{CLEAR}work, it’s finally a tourist spot.{SCROLL}Now tourists are coming{NEWLINE}here one after another.{CLEAR}All that effort wasn’t for nothing.

strings.zh: 飘浮泡泡『Caaa——fo！
strings.en: Castform: Caaa-fo!

strings.zh: 正是因为当年造船工业搬走后{NEWLINE}我选择了坚守在家乡三之岛,{CLEAR}才能亲身经历这里复苏的过程。{SCROLL}看到重新热闹起来的家乡,{NEWLINE}我心中当真是酸酸甜甜,难以言表。
strings.en: When the shipbuilding industry moved{NEWLINE}away, I chose to stay in my hometown,{CLEAR}Three Island.{SCROLL}That’s why I got to see it come back to{NEWLINE}life with my own eyes.{SCROLL}Seeing my hometown lively{NEWLINE}again gives me a bittersweet{CLEAR}feeling I can’t put into words.

strings.zh: {VAR:0101:0}想要记住{NEWLINE}新的加农水炮……！{SCROLL}但是{VAR:0101:0}{NEWLINE}已经记住4个技能了！{SCROLL}为了学习加农水炮{NEWLINE}要让它忘记其他技能吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: {VAR:0101:0} wants to learn Hydro{NEWLINE}Cannon...!{SCROLL}But {VAR:0101:0} already knows four{NEWLINE}moves!{SCROLL}Should it forget a move{NEWLINE}to learn Hydro Cannon?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 极梅婆婆『哦,是{VAR:0103:0}啊,{NEWLINE}你也报名参加了诸岛巡礼吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Granny Mae: Oh, it’s {VAR:0103:0}. Have you{NEWLINE}signed up for the Island Pilgrimage too?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 极梅婆婆『不是为诸岛巡礼来的？{NEWLINE}那就是来学习终极绝招咯？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Granny Mae: Not here for the Island{NEWLINE}Pilgrimage? Then you’ve come to learn{CLEAR}an ultimate move?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 极梅婆婆『如今你已经成为联盟冠军,{NEWLINE}再以普通方式考验你太没意思了。{CLEAR}这样吧,上次你们来学终极绝招,{CLEAR}是以2对2的形式打败了我和阿香,{CLEAR}这次你就用1对2的方式{CLEAR}再打败我和阿香,{CLEAR}就算你通过二之岛的考验。{CLEAR}你做好准备了吗？
strings.en: Granny Mae: Now that you’re the League{NEWLINE}Champion, testing you the usual way{CLEAR}would be no fun.{SCROLL}Tell you what. Last time, you two beat{NEWLINE}Dana and me two-on-two to learn the{CLEAR}ultimate move.{SCROLL}This time, beat Dana and me again, one{NEWLINE}against two...{SCROLL}...and you’ll have passed the Two{NEWLINE}Island trial. Are you ready?

strings.zh: 极梅婆婆『等你准备好了,{NEWLINE}随时可以来找我开启考验。
strings.en: Granny Mae: Whenever you’re ready,{NEWLINE}come see me and we’ll begin the trial.

strings.zh: 极梅婆婆『嗯,你去前面空地站好,{NEWLINE}咱们这就开始。
strings.en: Granny Mae: Good. Go stand in the open{NEWLINE}space ahead, and we’ll get started.

strings.zh: 极梅婆婆『阿香,你过来。
strings.en: Granny Mae: Dana, come here.

strings.zh: 极梅婆婆『这次的对手是联盟冠军,{NEWLINE}你要全力以赴,知道吗？
strings.en: Granny Mae: This time our opponent is{NEWLINE}the League Champion. Give it everything{CLEAR}you’ve got, understand?

strings.zh: 是,婆婆。
strings.en: Yes, Granny.

strings.zh: 极梅婆婆『那么针对联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}特别制定的二之岛诸岛巡礼考验,{CLEAR}现在开始！
strings.en: Granny Mae: The Two Island Pilgrimage{NEWLINE}trial, made especially for League{CLEAR}Champion {VAR:0103:0}...{SCROLL}...begins now!

strings.zh: 极梅婆婆『不愧是联盟冠军,{NEWLINE}实力果然远胜从前,{CLEAR}恭喜你通过二之岛的考验。{CLEAR}你现在可以去其他地方{CLEAR}继续完成诸岛巡礼了。
strings.en: Granny Mae: Just what I’d expect from{NEWLINE}the League Champion. You’re far{CLEAR}stronger than before.{SCROLL}Congratulations on passing the Two{NEWLINE}Island trial.{SCROLL}You may now go elsewhere to continue{NEWLINE}the Island Pilgrimage.

strings.zh: 哦？冠军大人光临三之岛,{NEWLINE}有何贵干啊？{CLEAR}水都群岛正在举办诸岛巡礼,{NEWLINE}你也是来三之岛接受巡礼考验的吗？
strings.en: Oh? The Champion honors Three Island{NEWLINE}with a visit? What brings you here?{SCROLL}The Alto Mare Islands are holding the{NEWLINE}Island Pilgrimage. Have you come for the{CLEAR}Three Island trial too?

strings.zh: 祝您在三之岛玩的愉快。
strings.en: Enjoy your time on Three Island.

strings.zh: 面对冠军大人您,{NEWLINE}用对战的方式考验毫无意义,{CLEAR}咱们换种新的考验方式吧。{SCROLL}为了打造三之岛良好的旅游口碑,{NEWLINE}就麻烦冠军大人您去岛上看看{CLEAR}有没有游客需要帮忙的。{CLEAR}等您帮助完一名游客之后{CLEAR}回到这里来跟我说一声,{CLEAR}就算是您通过三之岛的考验了。
strings.en: Testing you with a battle would be{NEWLINE}pointless, Champion. Let’s try a new{CLEAR}kind of trial.{SCROLL}To build Three Island’s{NEWLINE}good name with tourists,{CLEAR}please look around the island...{SCROLL}...for any tourists who need help.{SCROLL}Once you’ve helped one tourist, come{NEWLINE}back and tell me, and you’ll have passed{CLEAR}the Three Island trial.

strings.zh: 冠军大人帮游客找回走丢女儿的事{NEWLINE}我已经听说了。{CLEAR}多亏了这件事,{CLEAR}三之岛的旅游口碑又上升了。{CLEAR}我认可您通过了三之岛的考验,{CLEAR}请去其他岛继续您的巡礼旅程吧。
strings.en: I’ve heard how you helped a tourist find{NEWLINE}their lost daughter, Champion.{SCROLL}Thanks to that, Three Island’s good{NEWLINE}name with tourists has grown even more.{SCROLL}I declare that you’ve passed the Three{NEWLINE}Island trial. Please continue your{CLEAR}pilgrimage on the other islands.

strings.zh: 我来接受诸岛巡礼的考验
strings.en: I’m here for the trial

strings.zh: 没事,我就是来逛逛的
strings.en: Just looking around

strings.zh: 既然你通过了极梅婆婆{NEWLINE}的试验，那么我相信你一定{CLEAR}能用好这个道具。{SCROLL}这是我在卡洛斯{NEWLINE}地区游历的时候，{CLEAR}有个甲贺忍蛙的训练师{CLEAR}给我的，可以提升甲贺忍蛙{CLEAR}的所有潜力。{CLEAR}我相信你有甲贺忍蛙的话，{CLEAR}一定能发挥他的最大潜力吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Since you passed Granny Mae’s{NEWLINE}trial, I’m sure you’ll make{CLEAR}good use of this item.{SCROLL}A Greninja Trainer gave it to me when I{NEWLINE}traveled in the Kalos region.{SCROLL}It can unlock all of Greninja’s{NEWLINE}potential.{SCROLL}If you have a Greninja, I’m sure you’ll{NEWLINE}bring out its full power.{SCROLL}
